Business_Why: To provide immediate, empathetic financial relief to customers during times of loss, ensuring that the discount process is friction-less and supportive while maintaining corporate trust.
Strategic_Intent: Protect corporate revenue integrity by enforcing deterministic discount ceilings (15%) that override AI-generated pricing suggestions and mandate human-in-the-loop validation for high-variance overrides.
Inclusion_Logic: Includes international and domestic flight bookings where a death certificate or funeral home notice is verified via digital or voice channels[cite: 1, 5].
